Simple Granola
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 4:41pm

Ingredients




2 cups Whole wheat flour
1 cup Coconut
6 cups Rolled oats
Chopped nuts -- optional
cup Water
1 cup Oil
1 tablespoon Salt
1 cup Honey
2 teaspoons Vanilla

Preparation

1 Mix the wet ingredients and blend well. Toss the dry ingredients together, add to the wet mixture and toss to coat. Spread out on two greased cookie sheets and bake 1 hour or until dry and golden. Store in airtight container.
